feedback.Physical Object: Included — A tangible, bounded item that can be picked up, placed, or dropped; not just a system, but a device.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — Manufactured and assembled from engineered components.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — Not inspired by or modeled on biological systems.
feedback.Powered: Included — Operates on wall power or batteries.
feedback.Structural: Included — Enclosed in a rigid frame with defined internal layout.
feedback.Observable: Included — Time and alarm state are visually presented.
feedback.Physical Medium: Included — Composed of matter: casing, display, circuitry.
feedback.Active: Included — Continuously tracks time and monitors alarm logic.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Purpose-built to keep time and alert users.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Included — Produces sound, vibration, or light to wake or notify.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Included — Embedded digital logic governs timing and user input.
feedback.State-Transforming: Included — Cycles between idle, set, active, and snooze states.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Included — Designed for frequent user interaction.
feedback.System-integrated: Excluded — Typically standalone, not embedded in a larger control system.
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Not vital to any larger system's identity.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Constantly conveys structured information via display and alarms.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Operates on strict logic and programmed behavior.
feedback.Compositional: Excluded — Integrated logic and casing, not modular or abstractly structured.
feedback.Normative: Excluded — Does not encode rules of behavior or conduct.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Entire identity based on measuring and responding to time.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Functions are implemented in digital logic or firmware.
feedback.Social Construct: Excluded — Identity is materially and functionally defined.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Excluded — Not defined by institutional or legal classification.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not associated with roles or personal identity.
feedback.Regulated: Excluded — Only subject to general consumer electronics standards.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Mass-produced, globally distributed consumer good.
feedback.Politicised: Excluded — Not a subject of political or ideological tension.
feedback.Ritualised: Included — Deeply embedded in cultural routines (e.g., waking habits).
feedback.Ethically Significant: Excluded — No major ethical debates or burdens associated.

encoding_notes: This encoding treats the digital alarm clock as a discrete physical object with digitally governed internal logic. It is active, autonomous, and embedded in social routines, while communicating structured time information. Final UHT code: DFFA630A.
